meta.description: Lucsoft SL is a web studio on the Costa del Sol that builds websites from A to Z: strategy, design, development, hosting, SEO and ongoing care.
meta.availabilityDetail: Call, WhatsApp or write to us any day of the week — early mornings, late evenings and weekends included. We usually reply within a few hours.

hero.eyebrow: Web studio · Costa del Sol, Spain
hero.lead: Lucsoft SL takes your business online end to end — strategy, design, development, hosting and care. One team, one point of contact, no loose ends.

company.title: A company,
company.lead: Lucsoft SL is a registered Spanish company. You get a team behind your project, proper contracts and invoices, and someone who picks up the phone next year too.

points.title: Registered Spanish S.L.
points.text: Written agreements, invoices with IVA and clear ownership of everything we build for you.

points.title: A team, not a single point of failure
points.text: Designers and developers working together, so holidays and sick days never stall your launch.

points.title: Web and mobile under one roof
points.text: We also design and publish our own iOS and Android apps, so your website can grow into an app when you are ready.

items.title: Audit & strategy
items.text: We learn your business, your customers and your competitors before a single pixel is drawn.

items.title: Design
items.text: Custom visual design built around your brand — never a recycled template.

items.title: Development
items.text: Fast, secure, mobile-first websites built with modern tools and tested on real devices.

items.title: Bookings & shops
items.text: Table reservations, room bookings, online payments and product catalogues that just work.

items.title: SEO & languages
items.text: Search-ready structure, Google Business setup and multilingual content for international visitors.

items.title: Hosting & care
items.text: Domains, hosting, business email, backups, updates and edits — so you never have to think about it.

steps.title: Talk
steps.text: A free, no-obligation chat about your goals — by phone, WhatsApp, video or over a coffee on the coast.

steps.title: Plan & quote
steps.text: A clear written proposal with scope, timeline and a tailored price. No surprises later.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: You see and shape the look of your site before development starts.

steps.title: Build & launch
steps.text: We develop, test, connect your domain and go live — then show you around.

steps.title: Care
steps.text: Updates, changes and support whenever you need them, almost around the clock.

pricing.title: No packages.
pricing.lead: Every business is different, so we don't sell one-size-fits-all bundles. Tell us what you need and we'll put together a clear, fixed proposal — usually within a day or two.
points: Written quote before any work starts
Pay only for what you actually need

faq.question: How much does a website cost?
faq.answer: It depends on what the site needs to do — a one-page presence is a very different job from a multilingual booking site. After a short chat we send a fixed, written quote so you know the full price up front.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: We agree a timeline in the proposal. Smaller sites typically go live in a few weeks; larger projects with bookings, shops or several languages take longer.

faq.question: Can you take over or redesign my existing website?
faq.answer: Yes. We can review what you have, keep what works, move your content and domain over, and rebuild the rest.

faq.question: Who looks after the site once it's live?
faq.answer: We can. Hosting, updates, backups and content changes can all be handled by us, so you have one contact for everything.
